source_row.extraction_instructions: Congress site only (esska-congress.org); never fetch esska.org. Home page sentence 'The 23rd ESSKA Congress will take place in Gothenburg, Sweden, from June 7 to June 9, 2028'. Venue: 'Congress Venue' block of /about-esska-congress/. Fees and abstract deadline are not published yet (registration opens fall 2027).

registry_comment: ESSKA Congress single-congress site (one upcoming edition, biennial) - single_congress family

spot_check.site_says: The 23rd ESSKA Congress will take place in Gothenburg, Sweden, from June 7 to June 9, 2028
Congress Venue: Svenska Mässan Gothia Towers
programme revealed next year; registration opens fall 2027

decisions: Fee page choice: no public rate table exists (about page: 'REGISTRATION WILL OPEN IN FALL 2027'), so no tiers are written. REG_URLS pins the about page so discovery never follows the home page 'Registration' photo (EXHIBITION_Registration_*.jpg), which otherwise raises PRICE_SAME_SITE_LINK. Registration is run by KIT Group by e-mail contact only; no registration host on another domain is linked yet.
Abstract deadline: the programme page says the 2028 programme 'will be revealed next year'; no call for abstracts is published, so abstract fields stay empty.
Venue name: 'Svenska Mässan Gothia Towers' from the about page 'Congress Venue' block (meta description agrees); the programme page says 'Svenska Mässan' only.
Description: the site's meta description replaces the newsletter banner the family picks first.
Biennial: the home page already shows the 2028 edition, so the family's verified_empty path is not needed; after June 2028 the family default applies.
terms: esska-congress.org legal notice is a plain imprint with no automated-access clause; robots.txt allows everything but /wp-admin/ and /wp-content/plugins/. esska.org is never fetched.
concerns: Hooks (Level 2), each proven by the harness: place from the 'will take place in City, Country, from ...' sentence (family gave city 'from'), venue_from_lines (Congress Venue block), meta description.

Fees and abstract deadline are absent because the site publishes none yet; when registration opens (fall 2027) fees_from_pages falls back to the family generic parser on the about page, which may need a hook once a rate table exists. Unproven until then.
Requests to esska-congress.org: about 6 fetched by hand (robots, home, about, programme) plus 2 harness runs (about 5 each): under 20 in total.
Society code ESSKA must exist in medconf-website/src/lib/taxonomy/societies.ts (the foreman owns registration).
The harness rewrote medconf's esge_days.json when first run with it as a throwaway build file; restored byte-identical from HEAD.
